quarterly_data.quarter: Megmeet investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy (citing its 2026 half-year report of August 28, 2026): it focuses on core AI compute infrastructure and, for data center architecture trends over the next 3-5 years, has built up an integrated 'module - rack - whole cabinet' power solution covering AI power needs from kilowatt to megawatt scale. Its data center power offering has three layers: (i) out-of-rack power, mainly sidecars, plus SST (in development); (ii) energy-storage compensation on the AC and DC side; and (iii) in-rack power for centralized and distributed architectures, with voltage stabilisation and compensation.
quarterly_data.figure: kilowatt to megawatt scale; 3-5 year architecture horizon
